data_fields.name: cost_mp
data_fields.donor_constant: per-spell mana field (JSON key mana; C default 1)

data_fields.name: cast_time_circles
data_fields.donor_constant: per-spell cast_time (C default 1.0; JSON key cast_time)

data_fields.name: wind_floor_short
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 circles when base cast time is under 1.01

data_fields.name: robe_match_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 cap on equipment shortening (0.2 + 0.1 per beatitude point)

data_fields.name: fumble_safe_level
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 ability (non-book casts never fumble at or above)

best_idea: A cast's cost is paid as a per-tick drip during the wind-up with the rest charged at fire, the wind-up shortens with DEX, and a learner's extra wind-up and fumble roll are two separate, capped rules.
decision_why: Keep the drip-then-charge-at-fire shape, the DEX-shortened wind-up with floors, the capped learner extra and the fumble ladder; fix the integer drip interval and the mixed ability values; reject spell overdraw into HP for general casters because Frankendom keeps resources as pools on one ledger.
acceptance: A server test asserts a cast costing more than the caster's pool is refused before any pool changes, and a completed cast charges exactly its cost across drips and the fire remainder; a learner's extra wind-up is never more than the capped circles.
